name: Nitch
bio: Nitch was a Bad Lands local named in the paper's joking social notes, listed among the 'bloods' in town in February 1884. In March 1885 the paper reported that he had 'buried the hatchet' and sworn off temptation.

moments.label: Announced he had buried the hatchet
